summary: Private: upstream identity header truncated at semicolon after edge proxy upgrade causing scheduled-worker RBAC 403s
description:
Issue summary:
Customers on Private deployments (Finurex Capital) reported intermittent 403s from internal scheduled-worker tasks that call Redwood admin APIs. Error only started after an ingress/edge proxy upgrade rolled out to us-east on 2026-03-09.

Impact:
- Scheduled batch jobs that run as a service account are failing to perform admin operations (impacts nightly ingestion and billing reconciliation).
- Affects only the private VPC deployment for Finurex (us-east).
- Customer-facing runtime inference unaffected; admin API calls from control plane are impacted.

Environment:
- Private deployment (customer-managed VPC) behind Redwood edge/ingress v1.12.0 -> upgraded to v1.13.0 on 2026-03-09.
- Identity flow: service worker signs a short-lived assertion and a proxy rewrites it into X-Redwood-Identity header using NameID from SAML/IdP.

Observed behavior / errors:
- Admin API returns 403 with message: "subject authz check failed: principal mismatch".
- Identity header present but truncated at first semicolon character (";"). Example expected: "service-account+worker;realm=finurex" but seen: "service-account+worker".
- RBAC policy lookup expects the realm suffix and fails to map to tenant-scoped bindings.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Using customer's private environment, trigger a scheduled worker job (nightly ingestion) that calls /admin/jobs/run with service-account assertion.
2) Observe immediate 403 in job logs.
3) Capture incoming headers to admin API via debug route (/debug/headers) and note X-Redwood-Identity is truncated at semicolon.

Logs/Artifacts:
- Customer job log snippet: "2026-03-10T02:03:12Z ERROR job-run: admin api 403 subject authz check failed"
- Edge ingress logs (us-east, 2026-03-09T23:50 - 2026-03-10T03:00): repeated entries showing header-sanitizer component dropped bytes after ASCII 0x3B (semicolon).
- Debug capture from admin service: "X-Redwood-Identity: service-account+worker" (missing ";realm=finurex").

Initial hypothesis:
- Edge v1.13.0 introduced stricter header canonicalization that treats semicolon as a separator and truncates header values when set to 'token' mode. The identity-proxy earlier relied on preserving raw token payload including semicolon-encoded NameID attributes. Truncation causes RBAC lookup failure because tenant scoping suffix is lost.

Related links:
- Slack thread: #support-private (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01234567/p1678400000000)
- Edge upgrade PR: https://github.com/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/433
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Private+Auth+Header+Sanitization
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger scheduled worker job in affected private us-east environment
Inspect scheduled worker logs: observe admin API 403 errors
Call /debug/headers in admin service to capture X-Redwood-Identity header
Compare expected NameID (contains semicolon-delimited realm) vs captured truncated header
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 04:12 - Confirmed correlation between edge upgrade window and first customer reports
2026-03-10 05:30 - Reproduced in staging private cluster with edge v1.13.0: identity header truncated at first semicolon
2026-03-10 07:00 - Reviewed edge-proxy change log: new header sanitizer has option 'token_mode=ascii' defaulting to strict separators
2026-03-10 09:10 - Identity-proxy encodes NameID as 'principal;realm=...' without percent-encoding semicolon; older edge preserved it raw
2026-03-10 11:25 - Confirmed RBAC policy resolution fails when realm suffix absent; unit test shows mapping misses tenant binding when suffix missing
2026-03-11 02:40 - Customer workaround applied: updated identity-proxy to percent-encode semicolons in NameID, immediate fix for job runs observed
2026-03-11 10:00 - Eng assigned to edge-proxy team to evaluate sanitizer configuration and small patch to preserve header tokens or decode properly
comments: Maya Chen (Support): Logged initial report from Finurex on 2026-03-10. Captured failing job logs and asked for debug header capture.
Finurex Ops (customer): We saw ~80% of nightly job runs fail on 2026-03-10 after your scheduled edge upgrade. Happy to provide captures and allow a rolling rollback if needed.
Diego Alvarez (SRE): Reproduced locally in staging. Short-term mitigation is to update identity-proxy to percent-encode NameID semicolon. Pushing patch to customer's private control plane now.
Edge Team (via PR 433): We're tracking this as a regression in v1.13.0. Working on a 1.13.1 hotfix to stop truncation or expose a config flag to preserve semicolon characters in header values.
Maya Chen: Customer accepted mitigation and requested timeline for permanent fix. Also asked about potential impact to other tenants if sanitize mode remains strict.
resolution_notes: Workaround applied: percent-encode semicolons in NameID at identity-proxy level for affected private customers; customers confirmed scheduled jobs resumed. Edge team released v1.13.1 (hotfix) to restore previous header-preservation behavior and added integration test asserting identity header round-trip. Next steps: coordinate with Private deployments to roll v1.13.1 across remaining regions and update onboarding docs to either encode semicolons or use alternate delimiter. Follow-up task INT-1862 created to add an automated test in CI to prevent regressions.
